Martin Kohlstedt has long outgrown the confines of neoclassical music and has been drawn to electronic music for years, whilst keeping one ear attuned to the language of film music. He creates symphonic forms that are disrupted by synthesis and woven together through improvisation. This places him amongst the international pioneers who fuse influences from different worlds into a single, living whole, whether that be a film soundtrack, an album experience or a live performance.

For the first time in his career, Martin Kohlstedt is playing club shows with no seating. An exception to the rule. An event. In selected clubs, with limited capacity, powerful sound and special company: Aline Patschke . She has been studying drums at the Hochschule für Musik und Theater Leipzig since 2020. She writes her own music and plays in a variety of band and solo projects. As a multi-instrumentalist, she operates at the intersection of music, theatre and performance. Her openness to experimentation and interdisciplinary collaboration makes Aline Patschke not only one of the most exciting drummers of her generation, but also the ideal creative counterpart on stage for Martin Kohlstedt’s modular improvisations .
